readerCopy.body: An old hurt can look different once the desire, anger, or boundary that was shamed out of the story is allowed back in. When Chiron conjoins Lilith, sensitivity and refusal fuse, bringing an old rejection or criticism into contact with the part that became harder to admit afterward. It is difficult to understand what hurt while the want itself is still being treated as unacceptable. The meaning of the old injury can change once the missing desire is acknowledged plainly.
